sheets.title: West Point Virginia Armory — Cover Sheet / List of Drawings / Symbols / Code Information
sheets.reading_notes: Original 1989 armory construction drawings by KDA Planners Architects Designers for the Department of Military Affairs. Cover sheet lists a full set of civil, architectural, structural, mechanical, plumbing, and electrical drawings. Code information: 1987 Virginia Uniform Statewide Building Code. Use groups: Assembly A-3 (6,798 SF), Educational E (7,363 SF), Storage S-1 (5,560 SF). Construction Type 4 Heavy Timber. Total gross SF = 20,491. This is the original armory design set — NOT BFA's HVAC upgrade drawings.

sheets.title: Map Showing Topographical Features — 5.175 Acres, West Point VA
sheets.reading_notes: Topographic map of the 5.175 acre site. Site fronts on King William Avenue / State Route 30 and Thompson Avenue. Surveyed by J.K. Timmons & Associates. Date: 12-16-88. Shows 'Open Plowed Field' and 'Woods' areas on site prior to armory construction.

sheets.title: Layout — Virginia Army National Guard, West Point Armory
sheets.reading_notes: Site layout plan at 1"=30'. Shows armory building footprint, off-street parking lot (Additions 6 and 9 noted), military vehicle parking lot, utility storage building, wash platform with double swing gates, gas pump with concrete pad, fuel tank (gasoline, 1000 gallon noted), concrete dumpster pad. Site address context: King William Avenue (State Route 30) frontage, Thompson Avenue (50' R/W) along north edge. Title block: Department of Military Affairs, IFB-NGB-44-89-B-0120, Capital Outlay C-214(88-89), Project Code 13714, Agency Code 123. KDA firm with SMDI engineering subsidiary. Date 06.05.89.

sheets.title: Grading & Drainage — Virginia Army National Guard, West Point Armory
sheets.reading_notes: Grading and drainage plan at 1"=30'. Shows building FF = 30.00. Storm drainage with 24" RCP and 18" RCP structures. Detail of earth ditch shown. Note: 'All pipe shall be RCP Class III'. Structure schedule partially legible — some structures deleted as noted. Confirms same site layout as C-1.

floor_count.notes: Drawings in set are civil/site only (C-1, C-2) and original 1989 cover sheet. No floor plan drawings in this reduced set to determine floor count. Cover sheet indicates full set includes A-1 Floor Plan sheet.

conflict_flags.rationale: The 20,491 GSF from the original construction drawings represents true gross building area across all use groups (assembly, educational, storage). The 10,857 SF in TRACE 700 likely represents the conditioned floor area only — the model only simulates occupied/conditioned spaces. The conflict is explained by different measurement methodology (gross vs. conditioned), not a data error.
